response.justification: Bogdan possesses a highly relevant technical background for an Engineering Productivity role, with extensive experience in developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and mobile platforms. However, the position is a Level II Management role requiring full-time people leadership, and his resume lacks explicit evidence of formal people management, conducting performance reviews, or managing direct reports.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated technical leadership through organizing engineering workshops, code katas, and teaching TDD/Selenium courses.
Solid understanding of the mobile platform ecosystem, having developed iOS applications and mobile device orchestration tools.
concerns: Lacks explicit formal people management experience, which is a core requirement for a Level II Manager.
No demonstrated experience in leading large-scale organizational change.
Recent roles have been heavily focused on individual contributor (IC) work rather than full-time people leadership.
